candidates.node_relation: Large public copper producer with mining, milling, smelting/refining exposure; copper is a core material for grids, electrical equipment, data centers, renewables, motors, and broader electrification.
candidates.theme_relation: Direct upstream asset owner tied to the copper portion of the electrification materials chokepoint.
candidates.why_include: Freeport is one of the cleanest US-listed ways to map the copper-supply bottleneck into public equities. IEA 2025 flags copper demand pressure from grids and electrification, while Freeport reports multibillion-pound annual copper production.

candidates.next_evidence: Check 2026 production guidance, Peru/Mexico permitting and social-risk updates, reserve grade trends, treatment/refining charges, capex timing, and whether growth projects slip.
candidates.node_relation: Large copper miner with significant copper reserves and production, exposed to copper demand from grids, substations, cabling, transformers, renewables, and electrification.
candidates.theme_relation: Direct upstream asset owner for copper supply; relevant if copper becomes a second-order chokepoint across energy and power-grid expansion.
candidates.why_include: Southern Copper is an obvious large-cap copper producer with direct leverage to copper supply/demand. Its own 2025 filing discloses very large contained copper reserves, and its 2025 results disclose roughly 954,270 tonnes of copper production.

candidates.next_evidence: Quantify actual electrical-steel revenue share, capacity, utilization, contract duration, transformer versus automotive mix, margin contribution, and whether electrical-steel exposure is material enough relative to total steel operations.
candidates.node_relation: North American producer of electrical steels including grain-oriented electrical steel and non-oriented electrical steel used in transformers, generators, motors, EV traction motors, and charging infrastructure.
candidates.theme_relation: Direct specialty-materials supplier to transformer, motor, generator, and grid-equipment supply chains; potentially relevant if electrical-steel scarcity limits transformer or electrification equipment production.

candidates.next_evidence: Check lithium price scenarios, Energy Storage segment revenue/margins, contracted versus spot exposure, project deferrals, resource quality, brine/rock cost curve, and customer concentration.
candidates.node_relation: Major lithium chemicals producer with Energy Storage segment exposure to lithium carbonate and hydroxide used in batteries for EVs and stationary storage.
candidates.theme_relation: Direct battery-minerals exposure within the node; relevant to grid storage, renewable integration, EVs, and electrification demand, though lithium pricing has been cyclical and supply-sensitive.

candidates.next_evidence: Verify magnetics segment ramp, NdPr oxide/metal output, heavy rare-earth capability, offtake contracts, government/Apple agreement economics, China exposure reduction, and whether downstream margins become material.
candidates.node_relation: Rare-earth materials and NdFeB magnet supply-chain company with upstream Mountain Pass exposure and downstream magnetics buildout; rare earths feed high-performance motors, wind turbines, robotics, drones, and defense systems.
candidates.theme_relation: Second-order specialty-components/materials exposure: not copper or electrical steel, but linked to electrification motors, wind generation, and strategic domestic mineral supply chains.
candidates.why_include: MP is less directly tied to copper/electrical steel than FCX, SCCO, or CLF, but it is highly relevant to specialty material chokepoints for electrification because rare-earth magnets are used in electric machines and wind turbines. Include as a second-order materials candidate.

memory_update.text: FCX and SCCO are the highest-confidence direct copper candidates for this node because copper is core to the electrification bottleneck and both have large disclosed copper production/reserves.

CLF should be tracked as a scarce North American electrical-steel candidate, but its actual chokepoint relevance depends on electrical-steel revenue/capacity materiality versus the broader steel business.

ALB belongs in the expanded universe for battery-minerals exposure, but lithium cyclicality and project deferrals make the bottleneck thesis more price-cycle-sensitive than copper or electrical steel.

MP is a second-order specialty-materials candidate through rare-earth magnets for motors, wind, robotics, and defense; relevance is strong strategically but depends on execution of downstream magnetics scale-up.

This pass did not include non-US primary listings or private leaders in cable, transformer-core steel, copper wire, or electrical-steel supply chains; future passes should screen Prysmian, Southwire, transformer OEM suppliers, recyclers, and specialty component vendors.

node: Critical materials for electrification: copper, electrical steel, battery minerals, and specialty components
summary: Expanded the direct US-listed universe for the critical-materials input node. Highest-confidence candidates are large copper producers and scarce North American electrical-steel or battery/mineral supply-chain assets. The pass prioritizes companies with direct production exposure to copper, electrical steel, lithium, or rare-earth magnet materials rather than downstream equipment makers or utilities. This is research-universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
